text: The 2026 Banking on Climate Chaos report by Rainforest Action Network and other groups found that JPMorgan Chase was the largest financier of fossil fuel companies among the world's 65 largest banks in 2025, providing about $58 billion.

source.name: Rainforest Action Network (with BankTrack, Sierra Club, Reclaim Finance et al.): Banking on Climate Chaos 2026 press release
source.quote: JPMorgan Chase remains the #1 fossil fuel financier in the world, providing $58 billion to fossil fuel companies in 2025

additionalSources.name: ESG Dive (Lamar Johnson): Banks' fossil fuel financing increased 8% in 2025: report
additionalSources.quote: JPMorgan Chase was the top financier of fossil fuel financing for the third year in a row
